Quality Dental Implants, Made Affordable

Wondering how you can afford the dental treatment you need and want? At Roots Dental | Implant Center, we work with several financing partners to help make treatment more manageable through flexible monthly payment options.

See Your Financing Options
Want to speak to a real person for guidance?
Patient Spotlight
“My only regret is that I didn't start this sooner.”

1. Explore your options

Compare our trusted financing partners and find the payment option that best fits your needs.

2. Apply online

Complete a quick application online from home or with help from our team in the office.

3. Review your decision

Many applicants receive a decision quickly, helping them move forward with treatment sooner.

Lender Options

Each of our financing partners offers something different, from interest-free payment options to extended loan terms. Explore the options below to see which provider may best meet your financial needs.

Cherry
  • High approval rates for various credit types
  • No hard credit check to see options
  • Payment terms up to 24 months
Apply with Cherry
Proceed
  • Specialized in large dental loans
  • Extended terms up to 10 years
  • Lower monthly payments for implants
Apply with Proceed

Frequently Asked Questions

Will checking my financing options affect my credit score?

Several of our financing partners allow you to check available options or prequalify using a soft credit inquiry, which does not affect your credit score. A hard credit inquiry may be required when you accept or finalize certain financing offers. Review each provider’s terms before applying.

Are there application fees or upfront costs?

Application fees, down payments, and other costs vary by financing provider and payment plan. Some options may not require a down payment, while others may require an initial payment at the time of treatment.

Which financing provider should I choose?

The best option depends on your treatment cost, preferred monthly payment, desired repayment term, and credit profile. You are welcome to review more than one provider or ask our team for help understanding the available options.

Can I pay off my financing early?

Early-payment policies vary by provider. Some financing options do not have prepayment penalties, but you should review your individual agreement before accepting an offer.

Take the Next Step Toward a Healthier Smile

Explore your financing options or contact our team for help finding a payment solution that works for you.

Call Us!

Last Updated: Jan. 16, 2026

Roots Dental Implants is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website or use our services.

 

1. Information Collection
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you fill out a form, schedule an appointment, or contact us for support. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and any other details you provide.

 

2. Use of Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide and manage our dental services.
  • Communicate with you regarding appointments, care updates, and service notifications.
  • Provide customer support.

3. SMS and Mobile Information
No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. Information sharing to subcontractors in support services, such as customer service, is permitted. All other use case categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

 

4. Third-Party Sharing
Roots Dental Implants does not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to others. We do not share your data with third parties for the purpose of buying or selling leads. Information is only shared with subcontractors who assist in our standard business operations (such as our messaging platform or customer service tools) and only as necessary to provide our services to you.

 

5. Security
We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

 

6. Contact Information
If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, you may contact us using the information below:

Dr. Jacob Kaufman grew up in Newberg, Oregon, and now practices in Gresham, where he combines a passion for digital dentistry with a patient-centered approach to care. A graduate of the Oregon Health & Science University School of Dentistry, Dr. Kaufman completed advanced training through the California Implant Institute’s Fellowship in Implant Dentistry.

He specializes in guided implant surgery, digital treatment planning, and 3D-printed restorations—helping patients achieve lasting, comfortable, and natural results. Dedicated to continual growth, Dr. Kaufman stays at the forefront of modern implant and restorative techniques to help every patient reach their dental goals.

Outside the office, Dr. Kaufman enjoys life near the Roots Dental office with his partner Jan and their dogs, Dillard and Olive. He loves backpacking, golfing, and catching live music around Portland.

Flexible Payment and Financing Options Available

Here at Roots Dental Implant Center, we want you to be able to achieve the smile of your dreams! Although implants aren’t inexpensive, they are a great investment in your health that becomes affordable with great financing options. Dr. Chris Epperson, DMD

Dr. Chris Epperson earned his Doctor of Dental Medicine degree from A.T. Still University’s Arizona School of Dentistry & Oral Health in Mesa, Arizona. He first discovered his passion for dentistry while participating in humanitarian trips to Mexico and the Dominican Republic.

Nuestras Áreas de Especialización

Restauración Completa de Boca con Implantes

Las restauraciones completas de implantes bucales son conocidas por los pacientes como All-on-4, or All-on-X. Este tratamiento utiliza cuatro o más implantes por mandíbula para permitir la fijación de un puente de implante permanente cuando los dientes están más allá del punto de salvación.

Implantes Dentales de Cerámica

Los implantes dentales de cerámica son un tipo de implante que está hecho de circonia, un material cerámico fuerte y biocompatible. Son similares a los implantes dentales metálicos tradicionales en términos de diseño y función, pero ofrecen algunas ventajas únicas.

Implantes Dentales de Titanio

Fabricado con titanio de grado médico y probado con un largo historial de éxito. Las propiedades únicas del titanio ofrecen resistencia ligera así como biocompatibilidad que permite que el hueso crezca hacia el implante y se adhiera permanentemente al hueso maxilar.

Dr. Brian R. Hale, DMD

Dr. Brian R. Hale was born and raised in the desert heat of Las Vegas, Nevada. He graduated from UNLV School of Dental Medicine in 2017 after earning his Bachelor of Science in Biology from Brigham Young University. Following dental school he went on to complete a one-year General Practice Residency at the Veteran Affairs Medical Center in Baltimore, Maryland. During this time, Dr. Hale devoted his time to learning to place dental implants and advancing his surgical skills, many of which were performed in a hospital operating room. He and his wife relocated to Troutdale, Oregon in 2018.

As a general dentist Dr. Hale performs all procedures in dentistry, but he finds particular joy in providing dental implant services for his patients. “Offering single and full arch dental implants in our practice allows us to help our patients restore the smile and function they have been missing.” Dr. Hale is a graduate of Hero Dental Education and has begun taking courses with Pikos Institute in Tampa, Florida.

Dr. Hale is also fluent in Spanish, having lived in southern Argentina for a few years. 

Flexible Payment and Financing Options Available

Here at Roots Dental Implant Center, we want you to be able to achieve the smile of your dreams! Although implants aren’t inexpensive, they are a great investment in your health that becomes affordable with great financing options. Peer reviewed research has proven the connection between oral health and whole body wellness. A healthy mouth reduces the risk of many diseases, including heart disease and diabetes. Investing in your smile is an investment in your overall wellbeing. 

Learn More

Why People Love Roots Dental Implant Center

Bethany V.

Everyone seemed knowledgeable, helpful, and pleasant. The dentist, assistant, and hygienist were willing to explain and answer questions. They also paid close attention to my comfort level. Nice place and I will be making them my ongoing dentist long term. I also really liked their online booking system that actually worked for new patients – that’s a rare find from my experience and very convenient when finding a new provider. 

Salem

All the staff are excellent. Krista does my cleanings and does great. I’m a big baby with dental stuff and she makes it all OK Lol. Dr Huish is absolutely wonderful too. The staff work so well together. I’m very satisfied with this place.

The entire process was explained in detail. I have extreme dental anxiety, so the staff from the front desk, dental assistant, financial, and even the dentist took special care to reassure me, and make sure every step of my appointment that I was ok to keep moving forward. I felt I was in a judgement free space, which made it a lot easier to talk to the dentist about my fears.

They are also very understanding about the financial side of things here, and have provided great options for payment.

Adam Kearns, MS CRNA

Adam is a father of two young children and a Portland resident for 10 years. 

He started his anesthesia career at a Level One Trauma Hospital, providing care for trauma victims and Nuero-Surgical patients; in addition, he practiced at an inner-city cardiac hospital, providing anesthesia care for heart bypass patients. 

After several years of practice, he relocated to Portland to provide a better environment for his children. In Portland, Adam has practiced anesthesia in a variety of settings including city hospitals and rural settings.

Why People Love Roots Dental Implant Center

Bethany V.

Everyone seemed knowledgeable, helpful, and pleasant. The dentist, assistant, and hygienist were willing to explain and answer questions. They also paid close attention to my comfort level. Nice place and I will be making them my ongoing dentist long term. I also really liked their online booking system that actually worked for new patients – that’s a rare find from my experience and very convenient when finding a new provider. 

Salem

Liz B.

All the staff are excellent. Krista does my cleanings and does great. I’m a big baby with dental stuff and she makes it all OK Lol. Dr Huish is absolutely wonderful too. The staff work so well together. I’m very satisfied with this place. 

Salem

Kimberly S.

The entire process was explained in detail. I have extreme dental anxiety, so the staff from the front desk, dental assistant, financial, and even the dentist took special care to reassure me, and make sure every step of my appointment that I was ok to keep moving forward. I felt I was in a judgement free space, which made it a lot easier to talk to the dentist about my fears. 

Portland

Ronald G.

My experience was overall very good I was given all the details of the implant process and they answered all of my questions thoroughly and with compassion and patience they did not try to high pressure me just give me all of the facts related to my personal situation I do recommend this practice if you are interested in dental implants! 

Portland

Devin S.

Hands down this is the best dentist office I’ve ever been to. All of the ladies working here are super nice and friendly. I never felt more comfortable at the dentist. Sean is wonderful, and great at explaining things that would normally be over my head. They are also very understanding about the financial side of things here, and have provided great options for payment. 

Vancouver

Walter W.

A very pleasant first time visit to Roots Dental!
Great staff. Thoroughly answered all my questions. Melissa in office was great as were the entire staff. The Doctor was exceptional and I will feel completely comfortable in his care. No reservations, none. 

Vancouver

Dr. Seth Huish, DMD

Dr. Huish graduated from the Oregon Health & Science University School of Dentistry in 2013 and has pursued further education since. He has completed training in comprehensive orthodontics, continued education in dental surgeries, endodontics, and worked with special needs patients at a surgical center in Texas.

Dr. Huish is certified in oral and IV sedation and works regularly with a nurse anesthetist to ensure his patients are comfortable. With all this experience, he has found his niche, that being implantology. He has completed not one, but two fellowships in dental implant therapy. His well rounded background makes him uniquely qualified with the surgical technique and the restorative function and aesthetics. When not at the office, Dr. Huish is often out mentoring fellow dentists and training them on surgical and restorative techniques.

Dr Huish is living his lifelong dream of helping others, after he – himself broke his front tooth as a young man and was was helped by a dental professional.

Although from the pacific Northwest, Seth Huish graduated high school in Park City, UT where he met and married his high school sweetheart. He went on and graduated from BYU-Hawaii and is now the father to four beautiful daughters. Ask him about skiing, boating, biking, hiking, climbing or what adventure him and his girls have been up to lately.

Dr. Clark Brinton, DMD

Dr. Clark Brinton, a general dentist, has focused his career on dental implant treatments. His clinical practice is limited to dental implants, and he teaches other dentists about dental implants locally and nationally. Dr. Brinton is implant faculty for Dental Success Network, a National Educator for Neodent/Straumann Group and regularly invited to speak nationally at symposiums on dental implant treatment and emerging technologies.

Dr. Brinton, graduated as the class valedictorian from Oregon Health & Science University School of Dentistry in 2013. He served four years in the National Health Service Corps across rural New Mexico, where he honed his oral surgery skills and moonlighted providing IV sedation, third molar, and dental implant services. Returning to Oregon in 2017, Dr. Brinton began teaching other dentists how to place and restore dental implants. You can see Dr. Brinton’s ongoing teaching schedule here.

Dr. Brinton co-owns Element Dental Lab to meet the growing and complex implant restorative needs inside and outside his practice. He continues as an unrecovered CE addict, constantly attending and teaching implant courses. Dr. Brinton speaks nationally and is regularly invited to address the largest implant audiences in the United States. Dr. Brinton is one of the few implant dentists in the state of Oregon who is qualified to place zygomatic implants for those who don’t have enough bone in their upper jaw for regular dental implants. Dr. Brinton is the proud father of two daughters and one son.

Frequently Asked Questions About Dental Implants

What are dental implants?

Dental implants are artificial tooth roots that are surgically placed into the jawbone. They provide a strong foundation for crowns, bridges, or dentures, replacing missing teeth.

Are dental implant procedures painful?
Modern dental techniques and anesthesia make dental implant procedures virtually painless. You may experience some discomfort after the procedure, but this can be managed with over-the-counter pain medication.
How long do dental implants last?

With proper care, dental implants can last a lifetime. They are a durable and long-lasting solution for replacing missing teeth.

What is the recovery time for dental implants?

The recovery time for dental implants varies depending on the individual and the complexity of the procedure. However, most patients can resume their normal activities within a few days. Full healing and integration of the implant into the jawbone may take several months.

How much do dental implants cost?
The cost of dental implants can vary depending on several factors, including the number of implants needed, the complexity of the procedure. It’s best to consult with a dentist to get an accurate estimate. Many dental insurance plans cover a portion of the cost, and financing options are also available.

Check, Cash or Credit Card

We try to offer as many convenient options as possible for treatment payment. We accept most major credit cards.

Proceed Finance

Proceed Finance offers financing options for a large range of credit scores. Visit www.proceedfinance.com or call 844-272-7587 for more information, or let us help you apply by emailing us implants@rootsdental.com or calling (503) 234-7870. 

Sunbit

Helping people access everyday needs.
Sunbit technology is used by millions of people to pay over time for in-person services and more. The majority of people who apply are approved, interest rates are fair and transparent, and there are absolutely no late fees, origination fees, penalty fees, or penalty APRs. Visit sunbit.com/ for more information.

CareCredit®

One of the longest standing financing options in the healthcare industry, Care Credit makes financing dental treatment easy. Patients eligible for CareCredit financing can explore flexible and affordable monthly payment options. Visit www.carecredit.com or call 1-800-677-0718 for more information 

Cherry

Cherry is a fast and easy way to pay for your dental procedures over time. With a simple application process and instant decisions, Cherry offers flexible payment plans that fit your budget without hidden fees or surprises. Secure and Comfortable Denture Solutions

Implant-supported dentures provide more stability and comfort than traditional dentures, enhancing your confidence in speaking and eating. 

Schedule Your Free Consultation Today

Benefits of Implant-Supported Dentures

Enhanced Stability
Implants provide a secure foundation for your dentures, eliminating the worry of slippage or movement.
Improved Comfort
With a stable denture, you can enjoy eating and speaking with confidence.
Preserved Jawbone
Implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing bone loss and maintaining facial structure.
Enhanced Self-Esteem
A stable, well-fitting denture can boost your self-confidence and improve your quality of life.

How Roots Dental Implant Center Brings Back Your Smile with Implant-Supported Dentures

At Roots Dental Implant Center, we offer a superior solution for replacing multiple missing teeth: implant-supported dentures. Here’s how it works:

  1. Personalized Consultation: Our experienced dentists will assess your oral health and discuss your treatment goals.
  2. Strategic Implant Placement: We’ll strategically place a small number of dental implants into your jawbone.
  3. Healing Period: The implants will fuse with your jawbone, creating a strong foundation.
  4. Abutment Attachment: Abutments will be attached to the implants, serving as connectors for your denture.
  5. Custom Denture Creation: We’ll create a custom denture that fits securely over the abutments.

With implant-supported dentures from Roots Dental Implant Center, you can enjoy a beautiful, functional, and confident smile.

Why Choose Roots Dental Implant Center for Your Implant-Supported Dentures?

At Roots Dental Implant Center, we’re committed to providing exceptional full-arch dental implant solutions.
Advanced Technology
We utilize state-of-the-art technology to deliver precise and efficient treatments.

Our custom-crafted dentures are designed to look and feel natural.
Expert Dentists
Our skilled dentists have years of experience in implant dentistry, ensuring optimal results.
Enhanced Quality of Life
Implant-supported dentures can significantly improve your quality of life by restoring your ability to eat, speak, and smile with confidence.

Whether due to injury or decay, our single-tooth implants offer a permanent, natural-looking solution.

Schedule Your Free Consultation Today

Benefits of Single-Tooth Implants

Natural Appearance

Convenience

Permanent Solutions for Missing Teeth

Dental implants are a reliable and lasting option for replacing missing teeth. Our custom-made implants look, feel, and function just like natural teeth.

Schedule Your Free Consultation Today

Benefits of Dental Implants

Improved Appearance
Dental implants can significantly enhance your smile’s appearance, giving you a more youthful and confident look.
Enhanced Speech
Missing teeth can affect your speech, making it difficult to pronounce certain sounds. Dental implants can restore your ability to speak clearly and confidently.
Long-lasting Solution
With proper care, dental implants can last a lifetime, providing a durable and reliable solution for missing teeth.
Convenience and Comfort
Unlike dentures, dental implants are fixed in place, eliminating the need for messy adhesives or uncomfortable fittings.

How Dental Implants Work

Dental implants provide a long-lasting solution for missing teeth. Here’s a simplified breakdown of the process:

  1. Initial Consultation: Our dentists assess your oral health and discuss your treatment goals.
  2. Surgical Implant Placement: Titanium implants are surgically placed into your jawbone.
  3. Healing Period: The implants fuse with your jawbone over several months.
  4. Abutment Attachment: A connector is placed on top of the implant.
  5. Restoration Placement: Custom-made crowns, bridges, or dentures are attached to the abutment, completing your smile.

With dental implants, you can enjoy eating, speaking, and smiling with confidence.

Why Dental Implants with Roots Dental Implant Center?

At Roots Dental Implant Center, we’re committed to providing exceptional dental implant solutions tailored to your unique needs.
Experienced Dentists

Frequently Asked Questions About Dental Implants

What are dental implants?

Dental implants are artificial tooth roots that are surgically placed into the jawbone. They provide a strong foundation for crowns, bridges, or dentures, replacing missing teeth.

Are dental implant procedures painful?

Modern dental techniques and anesthesia make dental implant procedures virtually painless. You may experience some discomfort after the procedure, but this can be managed with over-the-counter pain medication.

 

How long do dental implants last?

With proper care, dental implants can last a lifetime. They are a durable and long-lasting solution for replacing missing teeth.

What is the recovery time for dental implants?

The recovery time for dental implants varies depending on the individual and the complexity of the procedure. However, most patients can resume their normal activities within a few days. Full healing and integration of the implant into the jawbone may take several months.

How much do dental implants cost?

The cost of dental implants can vary depending on several factors, including the number of implants needed, the complexity of the procedure. It’s best to consult with a dentist to get an accurate estimate. Many dental insurance plans cover a portion of the cost, and financing options are also available.
